title: Headset when remote control is on
description: While remote control is on, Muki wears a one-ear headset: thin band over the top of his screen head, one round earpiece on the side, a small boom mic curving toward the bottom corner of his face, and a short antenna on the earpiece with a slow soft blinking tip. It drops on when remote control turns on (quick happy squint) and lifts off when it ends. Fabio's idea, one earpiece chosen over a full two-cup headset (head is small in the band).
